Row.Text: People are often superstitious and the appearance of a comet has convinced many that the end of times is soon to come. Some believe that this portends fell times ahead. Others believe that they are in fact pixie fairies floating in the sky.
It's an omen, the end is nigh!
We live in good times, no such thing for nonsense!
Thank goodness we live in such enlightened time to witness this beauty.
The end is coming and you dare say we live in an enlightened time?!
